seo.title: AI website chatbot for any site | Steps AI
seo.description: Add an AI chatbot to your website in minutes. Works with WordPress, Wix, Webflow, Framer, Bubble and custom sites, with your branding.

hero.title: Answer every website visitor, even at 11pm.
hero.body: Add a chat widget or an inline search bar to your site. Your agent answers from your pages and documents, helps shoppers buy and hands over to your team when needed.
hero.reassurance: One script or a plugin. Your logo and colours. Separate desktop and mobile settings.

jobs.title: What your agent does on your website.
jobs.intro: The same agent you use everywhere, in a widget that matches your site.

items.title: Answer from your pages
items.body: The agent reads your website, FAQs and documents and answers in plain language.

items.title: Suggest quick questions
items.body: Show up to five quick questions so visitors know what to ask.

items.title: Help shoppers buy
items.body: With Shopify connected, shoppers add items to a cart and check out from inside the chat.

items.title: Capture leads
items.body: Collect the details your team needs during the conversation and save them to your CRM.

triggers.title: Make it fit your site.
triggers.intro: Everything visitors see is yours to set.

items.title: Choose floating or inline
items.body: Show a floating widget or an inline search bar, set separately for desktop and mobile.

items.title: Pick one of nine positions
items.body: Keep the bubble clear of your add-to-cart button on mobile.

items.title: Set when it appears
items.body: Show it straight away or after 5, 10 or 30 seconds, or one minute.

items.title: Match your brand
items.body: Use your logo, colours, light or dark theme, and your own greeting.

setup.title: Add it in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No developer needed for most sites.

items.title: Copy the script or install the plugin
items.body: Use the universal script, a framework snippet, or the WordPress plugin, which avoids WordPress removing script tags.

items.title: Paste it into your site builder
items.body: Guides cover Wix, Webflow, Framer, Bubble and WordPress.

items.title: Limit where it runs
items.body: Add allowed domains so the widget only works on your own sites.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: If you leave allowed domains empty, the widget can be embedded on any website.
State-level visitor location in analytics is available for website chats only.

items.a: Yes. Install the ready-made plugin, so you do not have to paste code into WordPress.

items.q: Can I show it differently on mobile?
items.a: Yes. Desktop and mobile display settings are separate.

items.q: Can customers buy in the chat?
items.a: With Shopify connected, shoppers can add products to a cart, pick a size or colour and check out from the chat.

items.label: Instagram chatbot
items.body: Reply to DMs and turn comments into conversations.

items.label: Messenger chatbot
items.body: Answer customers who message your Facebook page.

cta.title: See the website chatbot with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
